target.title: fix(line): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
Related: #90684

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where LINE users would see internal assistant tool-trace scaffolding (for example `⚠️ 🛠️ \`tool (agent)\` failed` banners and related XML/tool-call debris) in outbound replies when the shared delivery sanitizer was not applied on the LINE channel adapter.

## Why This Change Was Made

Sibling channels already wire `sanitizeText` to `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText()` under the #90684 hardening cluster (Slack, Signal, Matrix, Feishu, Mattermost, Telegram, Google Chat, QQBot, IRC, SMS, Discord, WhatsApp). LINE’s `lineOutboundAdapter` was missing that hook, so the shared outbound pipeline forwarded raw assistant text to LINE chunking and send paths.

This adds the same one-line `sanitizeText` adapter hook used by Mattermost/Slack and a focused regression test matching the sibling channel pattern.

## User Impact

LINE recipients no longer receive internal tool-trace failure banners or assistant scaffolding that other channels already strip before delivery. Ordinary assistant prose is unchanged.

## Evidence

Verified on branch `fix/line-sanitize-outbound-90684` at `cdf0ee3b0f7`.

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/line/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts --run
```

```
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  2 passed (2)
```

Regression coverage:
- strips `Done.\n⚠️ 🛠️ \`search repos (agent)\` failed` → `Done.`
- preserves ordinary prose unchanged

Lint (changed files):

```bash
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/line/src/outbound.ts extensions/line/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts
```

(no findings)
